entities.summary: Konstantin Anatolyevich Chuychenko is a Russian politician, businessman, and lawyer who has served as the Minister of Justice since 21 January 2020. Previously, he was Deputy Prime Minister of Russia and Chief of Staff of the Government from 2018 to 2020.
